items.title: Albert Francis Interview, 1961-08-04
items.q: There was a fella by the name of Saxon I believe that started that.

ctx.x: When did the saxophones come into the band? Do you know about? I had a record of it.
There was a fella by the name of Saxon I believe that started that. He was gonna say it's a fake instrument.
Yeah, but when did they start using them here in the city?
